text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ack... Despite my best efforts, the result
of my
last race was far too pitiful to offer
unto
Shiraoki...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But today... I will definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
As they say, "Even the patience of a
saint has
limits!" If I lose again, who
knows what kind of
punishment Shiraoki
will bring upon me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've made extra sure that
things will
work out this time! I
positioned my pillow in an
auspicious
direction, visited the shrine a hundred

times, and drew fortune slips until I got
"great
fortune"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
With confidence and luck on my side,
I'm sure to
win!
